title: Charge Session Start Delay
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session
| stats earliest(planned_start_ts) as planned, earliest(actual_start_ts) as actual by charger session_id
| eval delay_min=round((actual-planned)/60,1)
| where delay_min>15
| sort - delay_min
description: Measures how often scheduled charging starts late, a useful way to catch flaky timers, utility-control handshakes, or a charger that misses the cheap-rate window.
value: The whole point of smart charging is timing; this query verifies that your automation is actually hitting the overnight window you set.
implementation: Forward both planned and actual charger start times; alert on meaningful start delays before they cause a half-charged morning.
visualization: Table of scheduled sessions by start delay in minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when a charge you planned for cheap overnight power does not actually start on time.
